result.reason: The redline is narrowly confined to the warranty issue and preserves the original mutual representations and Globix exception. It supplies the fallback numerical periods and all three remedies, but it does not establish professional and workmanlike service performance, materially qualifies software conformance, and starts software coverage on the Effective Date rather than upon delivery or provision. It therefore does not fully satisfy even the fallback position. It also omits the preferred 12-month software term, 90-day services term, legal-compliance warranty, and malicious-code warranty.
